invariants.claim: The only source-visible external dispatch authenticates msg.sender as the immutable configured wrapper before invoking the internal override.
A decoded callback is ignored if the request is still in flight, status is not Drawing, the ID differs, the word count is not one, or the timestamp is at/after the callback deadline.
An accepted callback has exactly one indexable word and a nonzero, draw-frozen totalEntries value.
An accepted word maps to a one-based winningEntry in [1,totalEntries].
Acceptance writes winningEntry and resolvedAt, then changes Drawing to NftWon exactly when totalEntries >= reserveEntries and to CashWon otherwise.
Callback acceptance and Drawing-state refund activation occupy complementary timestamp intervals: callback before the deadline, refunds at or after it.
A callback made during the wrapper request cannot resolve because _requestInFlight is true until after the returned ID is stored.
The callback records the selected entry, timestamp, and result only; quote-token liability allocation remains in _settleWinningTicket.

calls.propagates: Returns zero before a request timestamp and otherwise drawRequestedAt plus the two-day timeout; fulfillRandomWords depends on it for the exclusive acceptance boundary (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L462-L465, L511-L515; target/packages/contracts/src/libraries/RaffleConstants.sol:L35-L36).

callers: VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.rawFulfillRandomWords authenticates msg.sender against i_vrfV2PlusWrapper and then dispatches to this override (target/packages/contracts/node_modules/@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/vrf/dev/VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol:L99-L107).
sharedState: status: requestDraw writes Drawing, enableRefunds writes Refunding, fulfillRandomWords reads it and writes NftWon or CashWon, and settlement/redemption consume the terminal value (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L252, L289-L300, L311-L315, L511-L521, L533-L536).

_requestInFlight and vrfRequestId: requestDraw brackets the external request and persists its returned ID; fulfillRandomWords gates acceptance on both (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L252-L260, L511-L515).
drawRequestedAt: requestDraw writes it, callbackDeadline derives the deadline from it, and fulfillRandomWords gates on that deadline (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L253, L462-L465, L512).

totalEntries: buyEntries advances it and builds ticket ranges; requestDraw checks it is nonzero; fulfillRandomWords uses it as the modulo divisor and reserve comparator (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L226-L233, L243, L518-L521).

reserveEntries: initialize stores the factory-validated threshold and fulfillRandomWords reads it for the terminal result (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L203, L521; target/packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L178-L179).
winningEntry: fulfillRandomWords writes it and _requireWinningTicket later reads it to validate settlement evidence (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L519, L579-L584).

resolvedAt: fulfillRandomWords is its source-visible writer; the value is exposed by the generated getter (target/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L114-L118, L520; target/packages/contracts/src/interfaces/IRaffle.sol:L488-L496).
